crosswalks.label: Data Scientists
crosswalks.rationale: Data Scientists ground statistical/modeling and evaluation work while Synthetic Data Specialist narrows to synthesis, utility and disclosure-risk evidence.

crosswalks.label: Database Architects
crosswalks.rationale: Database Architects ground data structure and quality context but do not own synthesis privacy or utility evaluation.

findings.summary: Synthetic-data practice must keep generation, utility and disclosure/privacy evaluation as separate evidence surfaces and scope all claims to exact source, method, population and intended use.
findings.rationale: Research-first compilation makes the specialist boundary explicit before use.

gaps_against_body.description: Make synthetic-does-not-mean-private and use-case-specific utility/disclosure boundaries explicit before treating generated data as reusable infrastructure.

nonclaims: No complete Synthetic Data Specialist reconstruction is claimed.
Occupational mappings are evidence, not profession identity.
No TEST/WORKING/CANON or adjacent authority is created.

high_stakes.authorization_nonclaim: No adjacent professional, user, legal, platform or institutional authority is created.
